_comment: Copy this file to ~/.hermes/whatsapp/gatekeeper_config.json and fill in your own values. Nothing here should stay as a literal placeholder in a real deployment.
intro_message_template_example: Hi, this is {assistant_name} — {owner_name}'s assistant. {owner_name} can't get to messages right now, so I'm stepping in. You mentioned {topic} — want to work through that together?
_group_auto_reply_enabled_comment: false = the assistant never automatically replies in group chats (listen/log only). true = normal automatic replies in groups. Flip and save — takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
_alert_profile_comment: Profile whose bot delivers owner alerts (owner takeover, round limit, fail-closed). Empty or "default" = current profile. Set this to the profile that owns the WhatsApp channel when one gateway process serves several profiles, otherwise alerts arrive from the wrong bot. Read live, no restart.
